static_traits.name: Yang Ming
static_traits.educational_background: Graduated from an Ivy League school
static_traits.social_status: Interactions with colleagues become strained due to self-pressure and guilt; has a few close friends but has not yet shared the related feelings
static_traits.medical_history: No history of significant physical illness; no previous similar psychological problems or consultation experience
static_traits.language_features: Clear and logical expression; markedly tends toward self-negation and over-attribution ('it is all my fault'); focuses on negative evidence and negates positive feedback; repeatedly analyzes and ruminates; cooperation acceptable but attitude rather negative

basic_info.main_problem: I believe the losses at my financial company are entirely due to my performance, which leads to guilt and self-blame.
basic_info.core_demands: Self-blame and guilt keep worsening and have affected mental health and overall well-being, and therefore seeks counseling.

core_beliefs: Bad outcomes are all my responsibility

special_situations.event: The company releases a negative financial report
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If the company incurs a loss, it means I am incompetent at work and the responsibility is mine
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Works overtime and takes on more tasks to make up for so-called shortcomings
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: It is all my fault，我害了公司

special_situations.event: Colleagues or superiors affirming or praising one's work
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If there is praise, it is mostly just politeness, does not represent real ability
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Downplaying or negating positive feedback, continuing to pressure oneself to avoid 'relaxing'
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: They are only saying nice things; they do not truly approve of me

special_situations.event: Alone after work or on weekends, recalling work performance
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If I cannot find and correct the mistake, it proves I am not good enough
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Repeatedly ruminating and constantly scrutinizing oneself in pursuit of perfect control
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: If I had done better, the company would not be in its current predicament

special_situations.event: Thinking about how others (colleagues/management) might view oneself
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: When the company loses money, others will definitely think I am incompetent or not working hard enough
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Proving oneself through overtime, while avoiding talking about real feelings with others
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: They think I am an incompetent person

core_conflict.wish: Longing to be recognized, seen as capable, and prove self-worth through work
core_conflict.fear: Fears being judged as incompetent and blamed as the cause of the company's losses, leading to negation and estrangement
defense_goal: Maintaining control and predictability over the situation by taking all responsibility
Using self-criticism and overwork to preempt others' negation and blame

object_relations.self_representation: A flawed employee who constantly needs to prove oneself
object_relations.object_representation: A harshly blaming judge (superiors/colleagues who will never truly approve)

object_relations.self_representation: An isolated, helpless person who is hard to understand
object_relations.object_representation: Others are people who do not understand and may even judge oneself

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When the counselor invites them to look for positive evidence or accept colleagues' affirmation
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: Believes these affirmations are insincere, worrying that the other party does not truly understand them (transference: projecting the fear of not being recognized onto others)
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Maintains gentleness and empathy, first reflects their doubt and burden, then explores evidence and alternative explanations with open-ended questions, avoiding confrontation and judgment.

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When advised to share feelings with friends and seek support
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: Believing others will not understand, expressing is equated with being 'dramatic' or 'meaningless'
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Proceeds with inquiry and validation in parallel, invites them to recall concrete experiences and evidence, gently challenges the 'useless' assumption, and encourages small-step attempts at sharing.

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When discussing one's own emotional experiences such as guilt/shame
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: Quickly turning to rational analysis of problems and data, downplaying or moving away from the emotional level
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Slows the pace, invites them to attend to bodily and emotional cues, concretizes and names emotions, uses short sentences and allows pauses to facilitate experiencing.

manifestations: Not sharing guilt and self-blame with close friends, believing they will not understand
Strained relationships with colleagues at work, subjective experience of 'not being truly recognized'
outcomes: Disrupted sleep and eating, exhaustion of energy
Interpersonal withdrawal and an unactivated support system

contact_model.definition: The individual attributes feelings they find hard to accept to others, corresponding to 'possession'. Language manifestations include: 'He is looking down on me', 'They want to exclude me', and so on
manifestations: Assuming others think one is incompetent or not hardworking
Believing the appreciation from superiors/colleagues is insincere

contact_model.definition: The individual restrains the impulse to act toward other people or objects, or gives up seeking others to do something for them and instead does it to themselves; that is, the individual redirects energy originally intended outward toward themselves, corresponding to 'impulse'. Language manifestations include: 'Forget it, I will just endure it', 'I should not trouble others', and so on
manifestations: Does not seek help from or express to friends, instead digesting stress through overtime work and self-harshness

contact_model.definition: The individual has a poor capacity for self-reflection and introspection, with excessive self-restriction and self-blame, and is overly cautious about contact, corresponding to 'autonomy'. Language manifestations include: 'It is all my fault that he was hurt', 'I do not deserve to talk to him', and so on
manifestations: Frequently self-blaming, demanding oneself with 'should/must do better'

contact_model.definition: The individual ignores or avoids a stimulus from the internal or external environment, deliberately avoiding direct contact, corresponding to 'acceptance'. Language manifestations include: 'Speaking of which... haha, just kidding', 'In theory...', and so on
manifestations: When invited in the session to see positive evidence, quickly shifts to emphasizing the negative and dismisses it with 'this is not important'

positive_force: High educational background (graduated from an Ivy League school)
Overall work performance has not noticeably declined; the foundation of professional ability remains
Has some social support (a few close friends)
Willing to try new perspectives and methods (expressing willingness to try in the session)
Has had moments of recognition from colleagues/superiors (though they downplay them)
negative_force: Strong tendency toward personalization and self-blame (blaming the company's losses on oneself)
Negating positive feedback and focusing on negatives (mental filtering, disqualifying the positive)
Mind-reading inference of others' evaluation, seeking external validation to prove worth
Rumination and overwork lead to energy exhaustion and disturbed sleep/eating
Strained relationships with colleagues, avoiding asking friends for help, social support not activated

target_behavior.core_reason: Attributes the company's losses to the self in a personalized way, attempting to find mistakes through rumination to restore a sense of control and certainty
target_behavior.function: Seeking a sense of certainty and control, temporarily relieving anxiety about 'incompetence'
target_behavior.consequence: Impaired sleep and eating, increased emotional burden, worsening relationships with colleagues

target_behavior.behavior: Excessive overtime and taking on an excessive load of tasks
antecedent: When worrying about others' evaluation or thinking others may think oneself is incompetent
target_behavior.core_reason: Compensating for the belief 'I am not good enough' through excessive effort and seeking external recognition
target_behavior.function: Escapes the possibility of being blamed and tries to gain others' approval
target_behavior.consequence: Long-term fatigue and exhaustion, efficiency not obviously improved, interpersonal relationships remain strained
